completionNotes: This phase consumes the process/revision handoff from #2077 without duplicating Structure, Dialogue or Visual Storytelling teaching.
Time-sensitive Industry facts remain historical or require current authoritative verification; current lessons teach durable categories and verification questions instead.
Responsible AI retains Human creative/canon authority, bounded context, privacy, provenance and explicit approval.
Collaboration retains local-first/no-cloud validity, contribution boundaries, privacy, rights, credit, provenance and explicit canon decisions.
Completing #2078 marks all 95 bundled source records audited for learner-facing source suppression while preserving every source record for provenance, search and RAG.
